issue.title: test_blocked_render_is_bounded_and_leaves_the_request_queued fails under just check full lane
issue.description: During unrelated commit-finalizer retry-loop verification on 2026-09-06, just check escalated to the governed full pytest lane (core-identity-changed) and failed this node once in a 38,856-item parallel run. The local diff touched finalizer code/tests, not agents_sync. Immediate unchanged rerun of both failed nodes with .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q passed: 2 passed in 5.39s, with this node taking 0.26s call time after setup. The broad run's retained temp log was truncated before the failure traceback, so the exact assertion still needs confirmation.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once under the governed full parallel lane reached by just check escalation on 2026-09-06, then passed immediately on an unchanged isolated rerun. Observed fail rate: 1 failure / 1 isolated pass in this run; serial reproduction not observed. The test uses a real 30s blocked render with a 0.2s drain timeout and an elapsed < 5.0 assertion, so investigate whether host load can exceed the wall-clock budget or whether publication drain cleanup can occasionally stall.

payload.description: Both are agents-sync publication-drain flakes that fail only in broad/load-sensitive runs and pass in isolation; sase-mb covered a different closed wall-clock backlog node.
